publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)

articleTitle: The level of labor quotas for commercial automobile Ro-Ro terminals based on TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: Currently, the major modes of transportation for the import and export of commercial cars are Ro-Ro because of its high volume and low cost. In order to address the lack of a scientific quota development approach for commercial vehicle Ro-Ro terminals, we present a TOPSIS-based quota development method in this study. The technique thoroughly evaluates the role of workers in Ro-Ro loading and unloading operations and takes into account the influence of three indicators on labor quota determination, namely the psychological quality, physical quality, and technical level of workers. By integrating the definition of the average advanced level with the weight coefficients of each index, the TOPSIS approach was utilized to thoroughly evaluate the employees and establish the labor quota level. The data collected at A Ro-Ro terminal also serves to validate the process. The findings demonstrate that the strategy suggested in this research can create a quota level that corresponds to the enterprise's actual production condition and can also serve as a guide for establishing and managing labor quotas in commercial Ro-Ro terminals.

articleTitle: Research on optimization of E-commerce automated storage layout simulation based on Flexsim
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: With the rapid development of E-commerce, there is an increasing demand for automation in modern industries. Automation is not only essential in the production process but also crucial in the intelligence and intensification of various logistics aspects. Driven by this overarching trend, the application of Automated Storage in logistics is becoming more prevalent. The main objective of this paper is to address issues faced by a certain e-commerce company during its operational activities. It utilizes the Flexsim simulation software to model and simulate the operational processes of an Automated Three- Dimensional Warehouse in the E-commerce domain. This involves effectively designing the layout and strategically planning entities within the warehouse. The paper further analyzes simulation results, proposes optimization strategies aimed at addressing identified issues, and ultimately aims to enhance the overall operational efficiency of the warehouse, consequently improving the company's productivity and profitability.

articleTitle: Coupling and coordination of road freight and economic development in Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei city cluster
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: In this paper, on the basis of elaborating the mechanism of the mutual coordination development of urban road freight and regional economy, the index system of coupling coordination degree between road freight and regional economy is established, and the mathematical model of coupling coordination degree is introduced to empirically analyze the coupling coordination status of road freight and regional economy in three areas of Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei city cluster. The results show that from 2013 to 2020, the overall level of comprehensive development of urban freight transport and regional economy in Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei is in a trend of steady improvement, but the development of urban freight transport in Hebei Province is significantly better than that in Beijing and Tianjin, and the development of regional economy in Beijing is better than that in Hebei and Tianjin; in recent years, the coupled and coordinated development of road freight transport and regional economy in all three places is transformed into a good situation, and Hebei Province always keeps the three In recent years, the coupled and coordinated development of road freight and regional economy in all three regions has turned out to be good, and Hebei Province has always maintained the best status among the three. Based on the research results, corresponding conclusions and suggestions are proposed.

articleTitle: Election theory of ship reference model and its application in motion modeling
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: Reference model is highly important for ship motion control. This paper studies the election theory of reference model and applies it to ship motion modeling. Firstly, a large amount of ship sea trial data are used to construct the main scale matrix. Partial least squares (PLS) method is used to determine the importance of each scale, and the main scale vector of electing reference model is obtained. Secondly, on the basis of the similarity principle, a reference model-based ship motion modeling approach is proposed. Finally, the accuracy of the modeling method is verified by using standard ship model test data, and the acceleration, dynamics and kinematics terms are compared. The method proposed in this paper can provide a theoretical basis for reference model electing in the area of ship motion control and identification modeling, and can also be applied to ship maneuvering motion prediction.

articleTitle: The construction path and practical exploration of "near zero carbon port"
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of green and low-carbon development requirements for ports, the concept of "near-zero carbon ports" has emerged and gradually become a hot topic in the industry. Based on the goals and requirements of the "dual carbon" strategy, this paper took the construction of "near zero carbon ports" as the starting point, conducted in-depth research and analysis of its development status, trends, and challenges, and took the C-section container terminal of Tianjin Port as an example to propose considerations for the construction path of "near zero carbon port".

articleTitle: Research on the operation organization mode of multi-level rail transit network based on accessibility
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: Strengthening regional multi-level rail transit connectivity can promote the sound development of the comprehensive transportation system of urban ag-glomerations. And it can promote the faster integration of regional cities and the improvement of overall competitiveness. This paper studies the problem of "how to choose the appropriate network operation organization mode". The evaluation index system is established, and the concept of accessibility is innovatively introduced. From the four aspects of urban development co-ordination, passenger service level, rail company operation effect and project implementation, the operation organization mode is determined by quantitative comparison. Finally, the research results are applied to the selection of operation organization mode of urban railway and urban rail transit in a city, which proves that the method has good applicability.

articleTitle: Research on the evaluation of green development level of large automated container ports
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: In the context of low-carbon and green development, aiming at the question of green development level of large automated container ports, a new multidimensional index system is constructed to evaluate the green development level of large automated container ports which based on the DPSIR research framework and principle of sustainable development, comprehensively considering the five key evaluation indicators of driving, pressure, status, impact and response. Utilizing the characteristic of cloud model method that can convert qualitative and quantitative indicators, evaluate the green development level of Yangshan Port Phase IV. Through the analysis of the results, it proposes countermeasures to improve the green level, and provides theoretical basis and practical guidance for the green development of large automated container ports.

articleTitle: A framework for unmanned equipment performance upgrade in civil airport at early stage
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: Airport is the hub of air transportation. Ensuring the safe and efficient operation of an airport is a highly complex system engineering endeavor, primarily characterized by its extensive scope, diverse operations, and constant dynamics. Currently, airport operations management and services heavily rely on manual processes, which present inherent limitations in terms of scalability. The existing airport management systems fail to adequately meet the evolving requirements of a smart airport. However, the airport unmanned upgrade and the integration of Cooperative Vehicle Infrastructure Systems(CVIS) hold immense potential to invigorate airports and represent an inevitable trend in their development. Against this backdrop, this paper proposes a novel framework for intelligent airport collaboration, designed as a proposal for unmanned airport upgrades to elevate the standards of airport management, operational efficiency, safety, and service quality. It also explores the application and development of this framework within civil aviation airports, while analyzing its similarities and differences in the context of CVIS. Lastly, the paper summarizes the advantages, challenges, and future prospects of intelligent collaboration technologies in civil aviation airports.

articleTitle: Automatic route selection of railway station based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: To realize the automatic execution of the train station operation plan and ensure the safety, efficiency and orderliness of the station operations, the key is to realize the automatic selection of the routes required by the station operation plan. The operation routes corresponding to the station operation plans were analysed and the network topology of the station yard through a meta-mode was built taking a certain station as the background. A mathematical model of automatic route selection of station operations, with the objective of minimizing the total delay time of all operations and the total travel time of the routes, considering resource conflicts between operation routes and the constraint conditions of the operation plans. The route selection problem was abstracted as a 0-1 integer model, and a heuristic optimization algorithm suitable for solving the model was proposed based on a genetic algorithm. The results through example analysis show that the algorithm can get the optimal solution in a short time, which meets the real-time requirements of route selection; Different delay factors and travel coefficients will get different optimal route schemes, and the route scheme obtained by focusing on delay factors is better.

articleTitle: Carbon reduction pathways and cost analysis of railway under TIMES model
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: Exploring the path and cost of carbon emission reduction of the railway sector has an important role in completing the carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals. This study improved the TIMES model, added factors such as carbon emission cost, to analyze the carbon emission and emission reduction cost in the operation and maintenance stage of the railway department. Meanwhile, this paper explored the relationship between transportation demand, energy conversion, carbon emission and emission reduction cost, and discussed how the railway sector could achieve the balance between emission reduction target and economy under different scenarios. Considering the representativeness of Beijing Railway Bureau, take it as an example for case study. The results show that train combination optimization, electrification transformation and so on have more cost advantages in emission reduction measures. However, this also leads to carbon emissions are very sensitive to electricity emission factors. So it is necessary to pay attention to the energy transformation of the power sector, and accelerate the construction of clean energy power generation equipment. At the same time, it is necessary to accelerate the development of CCS technology and reduce its application costs.

articleTitle: Research on the implementation and testing of blockchain-based information sharing system for emergency material distributionResearch on the implementation and testing of blockchain-based information sharing system for emergency material distribution
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: Emergency Material Distribution (EMD) is critical to protecting lives and property and mitigating the impact of emergencies. Currently, the traditional emergency material distribution information sharing system has hidden dangers such as data tampering and information opacity, and blockchain provides ideas to solve this problem. In this context, this paper designs and implements a blockchain-based full-cycle information sharing system for emergency material distribution, which provides a decentralised traceability solution. Meanwhile, this paper conducts simulation experiments to implement the designed information sharing system for emergency material distribution. The experiments not only verify the feasibility and efficiency of the system, but also show that the system has satisfactory performance and storage effect, providing a scientific basis for emergency decision-making.

articleTitle: Research on fuel consumption calculation based on QAR and ACR data
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: Reducing fuel consumption is an important part of improving the efficiency and quality of civil aviation operations and realizing the national strategy of ‘peak carbon dioxide emissions’. The industry and academia still use the BADA (Base of Aircraft Data) data model as the benchmark for the calculation of fuel consumption , but this method has the shortcoming of many influencing factors and large errors in the calculation results. This paper proposed a new method for calculating fuel consumption based on QAR (Quick Access Recorder) and ACARS (Aircraft Communications Addressing and Reporting System) data. For QAR data, the fuel consumption is calculated based on the flight altitude and fuel flow indicators which was used to identify each stage of the flight. For ACARS data, fuel consumption is calculated based on several key action time points and remaining fuel flow. The accuracy of the two algorithms is higher than 95%, and the QAR method is more accurate, but ACARS method is more practical.

articleTitle: An approach to point cloud and image fusion based on geometric features in water environment
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: The extensive application of intelligent equipment has effectively enhanced the ship's perception of the navigation environment and ensured the safety of the ship's navigation. LiDAR has strong anti-interference ability, and the spatial characteristics of the data are obvious. The video sensor can obtain vision information such as the brightness and chromaticity of the target. Studying the fusion of these two kinds of data and realizing the complementary advantages of equipment is of great significance to improving the safety of ship navigation. Based on the water transportation environment, we proposed a geometrical feature-based fusion method of LiDAR point cloud and image data, and designed self-feedback adjustment to reduce errors. Finally, we used the Cesium platform to visualize the fusion result. Comparative analysis shows that the accuracy of the fusion result after self-feedback adjustment is higher. Our method is computationally efficient and can be directly applied to front-end systems such as unmanned aerial vehicles and unmanned ships.

articleTitle: Prediction of peak carbon emissions from transportation in shandong province under the "dual carbon" goal
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: Through implementing a forward-thinking strategy focused on fostering the emerging energy industry and achieving the sustainable development goals of our nation, a predictive study was carried out in order to accomplish a "dual carbon" objective in the transportation sector across key areas of pollution. In order to obtain this objective, a comprehensive analysis was conducted on carbon emissions data from recent years in Shandong Province, a significant transportation hub within China. This examination was utilized to determine the overall carbon footprint, complete with an assessment of the intensity and trajectory of emissions trends.Develop a comprehensive Autoregressive Moving Average (ARIMA) model, creates two distinct prediction scenarios: a benchmark scenario and a "dual carbon" target scenario, and utilize scenario prediction methodology to compare the developmental trend of carbon emissions in the two scenarios. The analysis demonstrates an increase of 27.093 million tons of carbon dioxide emissions in Shandong Province from 2005 to 2022, with total carbon emissions displaying a slow growth towards its peak and later a gradual descent. Despite the downward trend, the total value still surpasses 30 million tons, classifying it as a heavily emitting province, thereby hindering sustainable transportation construction.This highlights the significant hurdles that the energy conservation and emissions reduction goals of the transportation sector in Shandong Province must overcome. To expedite progress towards national sustainable development, it is crucial to enhance policies, energy technologies, and structural frameworks.

articleTitle: Research on vehicle routing optimization in multiple distribution centers based on improved particle swarm algorithm
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: Aiming at the dynamic vehicle deployment in the field of modern intelligent logistics and distribution and the use of multi-distribution centers in related enterprises, this paper takes the minimization of distribution vehicle driving path as the goal, considers the capacity limitation of distribution vehicles, constructs a multi-distribution center vehicle path logistics optimization model, and combines with the characteristics of the model to design an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm to solve the model. The improved particle swarm algorithm introduces the concept of population evolution discretization on the basis of particle swarm algorithm to prevent the algorithm from maturing prematurely, and redefines the inertia factor of the particle swarm algorithm by combining with the characteristics of the Sigmoid function, which is controlled to change with the iteration in a nonlinear adaptive state. Finally, simulation experiments are designed to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm and model.

articleTitle: Research on prediction of product completion time in assembly jobshop based on SOA-RF
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: With the development of computer and artificial intelligence technology, the transportation and production logistics industry is gradually realizing the deep integration of intelligence, informationization, and industrialization. This paper takes the assembly jobshop problem with high complexity as an example, using the output feature data of simulation models to explore the correlation between the product completion time in the assembly jobshop and its influencing factors, and propose a more accurate prediction method for the product completion time in the assembly jobshop. Firstly, using Plant Simulation software to build a complete dynamic assembly jobshop simulation model. Then, according to the production data obtained from the simulation model, conduct feature variable analysis, and statistically identify significant feature variables as inputs for the prediction model. Secondly, adopt machine learning algorithms such as support vector machines, decision trees, and random forests to train and compare prediction models based on significant feature data. To further improve prediction accuracy, combine seagull optimization algorithm to improve the random forest prediction model, and design the SOA-RF prediction model. The experimental results show that the three evaluation indicators (R2, RMSE, MSE) of SOA-RF were 0.9041, 10.17, and 103.44 on the test set, respectively. Compared with the comparative algorithm, it achieved better performance and could provide precise data support for production logistics activities.

articleTitle: DWGCN: a route recommendation model based on deepwalk-graph convolutional network
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: Route Recommendation has been the foundation of trip planning, and although there are many studies in the literature, there are still many challenges. The first one is the problem of how to accurately obtain the spatial features of the road network; the second one is the accessibility of the planned route. To solve these problems, we propose a new path planning model, DeepWalk Graph Convolutional network (DWGCN). The model learns the spatial features of the road network from historical trajectory data by DeepWalk combination with GCN. A Multi-Layer Perceptron component (MLP) is used to estimate the conditional transfer distribution. We finally validate the model with five real datasets, and the experimental results show that our model has some improvements in precision, recall rate and reachability compared with the benchmark model.

articleTitle: Improving container shipping profitability by implementing target show-up rate and dead freight
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: Container shipping has been regarded as the backbone of the global maritime logistics system. There usually exist severe cancellations of container slots bookings by the customers (i.e., consignors) in the container shipping market, which significantly affect the capacity utilization and the profitability of a shipping company. Inspired by the practice of the global shipping companies (such as Maersk), this paper proposes the concept of the target show-up rate and dead freight to control the customer's cancellation behaviour. The target show-up rate indicates the show-up rate of the booked slots that should be satisfied by the customers; otherwise, the dead freight will be charged by the shipping company for the unfulfillment of booked container slots. This paper first extends the Newsvendor model to attain the relationship among optimal booking number, target show-up rate and unit dead freight. Based on this relationship, an optimization model is formulated to optimize the target rate and dead freight to maximize profit of the shipping company. The optimal conditions of these two terms are also obtained. Finally, a case study shows that considering the target show-up rate and dead freight can significantly improve the profit of the shipping companies.

articleTitle: Risk assessment of urban rail transit based on fuzzy consistent matrix and analytic hierarchy process
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: The urban rail transit carries a large amount of passenger flow and has high operational reliability and safety requirements. Risk assessment of urban rail transit can improve the comprehensiveness and pertinence of operation and maintenance. In response to the problems of inconsistent comparison matrices and long decision-making time in traditional analytic hierarchy process, a risk assessment method for urban rail transit was designed by introducing fuzzy consistent matrices, combining fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method and analytic hierarchy process. A risk assessment index system and risk assessment model for urban rail transit were constructed. Based on actual operational data, experts conducted risk assessments on the urban rail transit in Chengdu and Hangzhou, and determined the risk factors that have a significant impact on the operational safety of the urban rail transit. Compared with the traditional analytic hierarchy process, the analysis results show that this method can effectively assess the risk of urban rail transit, provide reference for the operation and maintenance of urban rail transit, and has the advantages of consistent comparison matrices and high decision-making efficiency.

articleTitle: Spatio-temporal evolution of major port efficiency in Zhejiang Province under the background of "Belt and Road"
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: Zhejiang Province, as a vital hub in China's "Belt and Road" strategy, holds significant research significance in terms of port efficiency. Ports, as crucial nodes in the trade and transportation system, play a pivotal role in evaluating port development through their operational efficiency. This study examines the impact of environmental factors, including inland economic level and regional industrial structure, on port efficiency and analyzes the spatiotemporal evolution of port efficiency using a three-stage DEA approach. The results indicate that the average port efficiency in Zhejiang Province from 2011 to 2020 is relatively low, exhibiting a certain degree of fluctuation over time with a stable upward trend. After removing the environmental factors, there is a substantial decrease in overall scale efficiency while pure technical efficiency shows a significant improvement, suggesting estimation bias in port efficiency due to environmental factors. Moreover, coastal ports demonstrate noticeably higher efficiency compared to inland ports in terms of spatial distribution. Finally, targeted strategies and recommendations are proposed to enhance the comprehensive competitiveness of Zhejiang Province's ports within the framework of China's "Belt and Road" strategy.

articleTitle: Dynamic assessment of the vulnerability of emergency logistics system
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: Due to the uncertain interference of the external and internal environment of the system, the vulnerability of emergency logistics system (ELS) has become increasingly prominent. Based on the VSD (Vulnerability-Scoping-Diagram) model, this study provides a vulnerability assessment index of ELS with 16 indicators in 3 dimensions (exposure, sensitivity and adaptability). Then, a system dynamic model (SDM) is constructed to simulate and assess the ELS vulnerability and an empirical study is carried out by using the data of Shaanxi Province. The findings show that the ELS vulnerability is on the decline in Shaanxi from 2012 to 2020. Specifically, the adaptability is rising annually, the sensitivity shows a downward trend with a small fluctuation, and the curve of exposure is consistent with vulnerability and has a declining trend direction. The results give beneficial enlightenment for governors and other social organizations. This study provides a new way to explore and resolve the vulnerability issue of ELS.

articleTitle: Evaluation of road performance and deicing effect of high-elastic/salt-storage asphalt pavement
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: High-elastic/salt-storage asphalt pavement combines the advantages of high-elastic material and salt-storage material, which can achieve better deicing effect without reducing road performance. Aiming at the problem that the design of high-elastic/salt-storage pavement lack of unified evaluation index of deicing effect, a new evaluation method and index to describe the performance of deicing was detected. The main conclusions are as follows: 1) The road performance of the four mixtures of SBS, SBS+MFL, SBS+RP and SBS+MFL+RP are reduced, the influence degree of modified material can meet the requirements of the specification. 2) At the initial stage of traffic and the equivalent precipitation of 4mm road surface water, the freezing point of this technology is-6.9°C, while the freezing point of single salt-storage asphalt pavement is-1.7°C, and the freezing point of single high-elastic asphalt pavement is-3.5°C.

articleTitle: Green cold chain vehicle path optimisation considering carbon emissions
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: In response to the current issue of incomplete consideration of comprehensive delivery costs optimization in cold chain distribution, this paper proposes a route optimization model with the aim of minimising comprehensive delivery costs, taking into account the characteristics of cold chain distribution. This model involves considering basic transportation costs, carbon emissions, refrigeration, cargo damage, and time window constraints. Subsequently, an improved genetic algorithm incorporating the optimisation operator α is proposed to solve the optimization model. Finally, simulation experiments show that the new algorithm achieves reductions of 17.58% in total distance, 4.61% in cargo damage costs, and 22.06% in carbon emissions compared to traditional methods. This validates the effectiveness of the proposed optimization model and improved algorithm, and signifies the significance of researching the optimization problem of fresh product cold chain distribution routes under the concept of low-carbon sustainable development. This research contributes to the transition of the cold chain transportation industry towards a low-carbon economy.

articleTitle: Evaluation of port logistics competitiveness based on partial order set
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: Ports are crucial hubs for foreign trade, and evaluating the competitiveness of port logistics can provide reference for the development of port logistics around the Bohai Sea. This article evaluates the competitiveness of ports around the Bohai Sea using partial order sets from five aspects: the hard conditions, operating conditions, development potential, and hinterland support of ports. When evaluating the competitiveness of port logistics, the precise weights of evaluation indicators are often difficult to obtain, making decision-making difficult. For this reason, the poset model is used for evaluation in this paper, and only needs to know the weight order of the indicators to conduct scheme evaluation. Firstly, the combination weighting method is used to obtain the order of indicator weights. Secondly, a Hasse diagram is drawn based on the partial order relationship, and the robustness of the scheme is analyzed through the Hasse diagram. The results show that the model is easy to operate, does not require precise weights, and can also be used for scheme evaluation, and this method can enhance the robustness of sorting. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified through comparative analysis and simulation. The results show that Qingdao and Tianjin ports belong to the first tier cluster and have the strongest competitiveness; Yantai, Rizhao, and Dalian belong to the second tier cluster, with moderate competitiveness. Yingkou belongs to the third tier cluster, while Qinhuangdao belongs to the fourth tier cluster, with the weakest competitiveness.

articleTitle: Modelling commuting mode choice behaviour with the consideration of the effects of COVID-19: a case study in Belgium
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: To quantify the effect of COVID-19 on commuting mode choice, we investigated the commuting situation of 9,000 companies in Belgium in 2017 and 2021. A Multinomial Logit Model was constructed to analyse the effects of different factors on commuting mode choice and how these effects changed before and after the pandemic. Combined with some existing transport policies in Belgium, several scenarios were also constructed to predict the characteristics of the commuting mode choice in the post-pandemic era. The results show that the effect of travel distance on commuting mode choice is diminishing. Reducing the subsidies for motor vehicles has the potential to reduce the commuters' reliance on driving cars. The attractiveness of non-motorised vehicles for commuting purposes can be increased by improving road safety. Furthermore, ensuring the match of public transport schedules with working hours emerged as a major concern for commuters in the post-pandemic era. These findings can not only provide a guideline for traffic management authorities in the post-pandemic era, but also provide valuable insights for dealing with major health events in future urban transport planning.

articleTitle: Risk assessment of water traffic accidents considering coupling effects
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: To maintain the safety of ship navigation and analyse the relationship between water traffic accidents and their influence factors, this article proposes a two-stage risk assessment model based on correlation analysis method and Bayesian network theory. In the first stage, preselecting the influence factors that affect the severity of water traffic accidents through literature review and expert opinions, considering the correlated characteristics of the influencing factors, Pearson correlation analysis method is used to analyse the relevance between the influencing factors; in the second stage, the Bayesian network theory is used to establish a risk assessment model for water traffic accidents, the parameters of the Bayesian network is trained based on the water traffic accident investigation reports, considering the problem of missing statistical data, the expectation maximization algorithm is used to compensate, then analyse coupling relationship between influencing factors in different scenarios by adjusting the states between different influencing factors. The research results indicate that the two most conflicting factors among single factors are ship factors and personal factors in order; the strongest coupling effect between any two factors is environmental factors and ship factors. The research results can provide theoretical reference for maritime departments to improve ship navigation safety.

articleTitle: Research on home appliance e-commerce logistics and transportation services based on customer satisfaction
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: The development of e-commerce has driven the logistics and transportation industry to provide impetus for socio-economic development. Analyzing the current situation of e-commerce logistics and transportation services from a customer perspective can help identify problems, improve and enhance logistics and transportation service capabilities, and promote high-quality development of the transportation industry. This article develops a quality measurement scale for home appliance e-commerce logistics transportation services based on customer perception under the framework of the international customer satisfaction evaluation model, combined with the SERVQUAL evaluation method. It constructs a structural equation model for the relationship between home appliance e-commerce logistics transportation services and customer satisfaction, and uses questionnaire survey method to collect data for empirical research. Verified the positive impact of customer perceived dimensions of home appliance e-commerce logistics and transportation services on customer satisfaction, as well as the research hypotheses involved in the research model, and proposed relevant suggestions for the development of the home appliance e-commerce logistics and transportation industry.

articleTitle: A method for analysing the development trend of waterway transportation based on text mining of maritime laws and regulations
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: As an important basis for the waterway traffic organization and management, Maritime laws and regulations play an important role in ensuring the safety of waterway traffic and in the construction of the all-factor "big traffic management" on water. This article uses the LDA topic model to deep explore and analyse current maritime laws and regulations from multiple perspectives such as era and institution. By analysing the distribution probability of the topics and calculating the ratio of the topics of the documents and combining with the world shipping development dynamics, it analyses the development trends and potential problems of water transportation in crew training, ship registration, port construction, navigation management, water pollution prevention, etc., providing new perspectives and ideas for water transportation organization and management, As well on theoretical support for the planning, construction, and innovative application of water transportation.

articleTitle: Heterogeneity analysis of passengers' choice behaviour between demand responsive train and traditional fixed train
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: Technological advances have drawn attention to demand responsive transportation as it changes passengers' travel behaviour and influences their travel choices. This study obtains data on passengers' travel choice behaviour through a stated preference survey and constructs a random parameters Logit model to analyse the effects of passengers' personal attributes and train attributes on the choice behaviour heterogeneity from the individual perspectives. Based on the travel distance, short-haul travel scenario (SHTS) and long-haul travel scenario (LHTS) are specifically simulated to assess the travel preferences of passengers under different scenarios. The research shows that passengers are more likely to choose demand responsive trains in both scenarios, and personal attributes such as gender and age are also important factors influencing train choice behaviour. Furthermore, the willingness-to-pay (WTP) analysis reveals that SHTS passengers are willing to pay CNY7.951 more for a 10min reduction in running time, and LHTS passengers are willing to pay CNY1.146 more for a 10min reduction in demand responsive time. The proposal of demand responsive trains for high-speed railways helps railway companies to optimize the use of train resources and promote sustainable development.

articleTitle: Research on state dependent differentiation field model based on pedestrian micro motion characteristics
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: It is of great theoretical and practical significance to study the micro movement and behavior of pedestrians in the channel. Based on the cellular automata model, this paper proposes a state related differentiated field model by improving the speed difference, changing selection probability of the righ t side w a lking preference, reflecting the state correlation of pedestrian decision making, and building the differentiated conflict resolution mechanism in different directions. Through a channel simulation program, the original model and the improved model are compared and verified. The verification shows that the improved field model can describe accurately the behavior of pedestrian following, layering and self organization in the channel, and has good application value.

articleTitle: Railway passenger kilometres forecasting with combined multi-grey BP neural network model
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: Accurate forecasting of railway passenger kilometers (RPK) plays an important role in optimizing the allocation of railway passenger transport organization resources. Considering the multi-correlation influencing factors and grey characteristics of railway passenger kilometers in China, a forecasting method of combined multi-grey BP neural network model (G_GMBP) based on grey correlation is constructed. The BP neural network is used to optimize the preliminary prediction results of three grey models: traditional GM(1,1) model, unbiased GM(1,1) model and power function method improved unbiased GM(1,1) model. Meanwhile, the main influence index of railway passenger kilometers extracted by grey correlation analysis is added as another part of the input of BP neural network, and the combined weights are adjusted according to the error back propagation. Through data training, the optimal weight coefficient is obtained and the data characteristics are fully fitted. Finally, a case study is carried out based on the real data of railway passenger kilometers in China from 2000 to 2019, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed model. The empirical results demonstrate that the prediction effect of the G_GMBP model is obviously better than the comparative predict ion method, and significantly improves the performance of RPK prediction.

articleTitle: Research on the assessment method of urban airspace zoning based on obstacle threat levels
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: In order to ensure the safe operation of urban airspace, this paper proposes an innovative approach to delineate urban airspace using obstacle threat levels. It suggests evaluating the safety margin between unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and obstacles based on the concept of risk transition zones. Taking the example of Liuhe District in Nanjing City, obstacle expansion boundaries are formed with the application of convex hull algorithm, and the expanded area is considered as the risk transition zone between high and low-risk areas in urban airspace. Based on obstacle threat levels, the research area can be roughly categorized into no-fly zones, high-risk zones, high-risk transition zones, medium-risk zones, and low-risk zones. Micro, light, and small UAV airspace environmental risk maps are generated using inverse distance weighting interpolation. Experimental results indicate that the proportion of risk transition zones in the study area for micro, light, and small UAVs is 3.0%, 11.0%, and 3.7%, respectively. This can be used to assess the safety margin between UAVs and obstacles, providing a scientific basis for the safe operation of different types of UAVs in urban airspace.

articleTitle: A nonlinear optimization-based bus OD matrix prediction model under information deficiency
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: OD(origin-destination) data, formed by the boarding and alighting points of all passengers, is crucial for bus scheduling and dispatching in ground public transportation. However, most cities only collect data on passenger boarding through fare collection systems, but the alighting information is missed, which makes analyzing OD data difficult. The common method for OD matrix research involves inferring passenger alighting points through travel chain theory, but this has limitations and high demands for data and computing power, making it hard to generalize. This model defines the OD matrix prediction problem as a nonlinear optimization problem based on basic passenger travel patterns and transforms it into a quadratic programming model. By calculating the global optimum solution, it can directly compute the parameters of the OD matrix and achieve accurate predictions at most stations. The model reduces dependence on historical data and allows for quick calculation of OD matrices, making it a valuable reference for incomplete database public transportation OD research. Experiments verified the model's accuracy, with average prediction error rates of OD matrix elements within 18%.

articleTitle: Comparison and selection of passenger transportation technology scheme for cruise terminal with large water level difference
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: Yangtze River cruise tourism is an important growth point driving regional economic development. At present, there are many problems in the passenger transportation at the Yangtze River cruise terminal, such as overcrowding of berths, insufficient facilities for connecting ship shore channels, and inconvenience for personnel and luggage to get on and off. Especially in the upper reaches of the Yangtze River, due to the large water level difference, the existing passenger terminals adopt a sloping or floating way, which have not solved the comfort problem for passengers. In this paper, comparative research is conducted on technical issues, such as assistance method, water avoidance method, ship shore connection method, and channel formation method, to determine the key factors that need to be considered in process design. An innovative vertical terminal passenger transportation process system with large water level difference is proposed. This vertical terminal can meet the usage requirements of various groups of people very well. The passenger passage is easy to close throughout the process and provide a good passenger experience.

articleTitle: Enhancing travel resilience: integrating alternative path-based robustness metric in route optimization
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: Unforeseen disruptions, including accidents, adverse weather conditions, and temporary construction, frequently hinder traffic flow in road transportation, forcing passengers to alter their routes. These incidents impart stress and delays on travelers. This article delves into the optimization of itineraries to minimize the impact of disruptions on passengers' journeys, with a focus on the criteria to be considered. We present a new metric for topological robustness that focuses on alternative paths and can be integrated into passengers' decision-making processes for choosing a route. Our simulations, based on static traffic assignment and varying levels of robustness, demonstrate that these robust paths are an effective way to mitigate travel delays and excessive travel time during disruptions.

articleTitle: Vehicle localization and tracking by using low-cost roadside millimeter-wave radar
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: This study develops a vehicle localization and tracking sys- tem based on a 24 GHz roadside MMW (Millimeter-Wave) radar. To mitigate MUI (Multipath Interference) caused by signal reflection in complex environment, this research pro- poses an integrated system that combines preprocessing, clus- tering, and trajectory estimation. A vehicle-tailored prepro- cessing algorithm is used to filter the raw data to reduce the al- gorithm complexity, followed by applying DBSCAN (Density- Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise) algo- rithm to handle unknown target counts in multi-vehicle sce- narios. Then, an innovative arc matching algorithm collab- orates with the radar to estimate vehicle trajectories. Ex- perimental results show that both Root Mean Square Error (RMS) and Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of vehicle trajectory matching are below 0.051 meters and have 67% target detec- tion accuracy.

articleTitle: A recommended crash risk prediction model for freeway segment considering heterogeneous effects
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: Crash risk analysis has been conducted to investigate the crash mechanisms and analyze the contributing factors from the aspects of traffic operation and geometric design perspectives. Using Yongtaiwen freeway rear-end crashes, traffic flow, and road alignment data, this study focused on investigating the heterogeneous impact of different contributing factors on crash risk. Aiming at investigating the heterogeneous effects of geometric characteristics on crash risk, a Latent Class Analysis (LCA) method is proposed to classify the samples. Aiming at studying the heterogeneous effects of traffic operational states on crash risk, a Latent Profile Analysis (LPA) method is proposed to classify the samples. Based on the classified homogeneous subgroups of crashes, logit models were used to study the relationship between microscopic traffic flow variables and crash risk. In addition, a latent class logit (LCL) model was also developed to simultaneously analyze the heterogeneous effects of geometric design features and traffic operational states on crash risk. The modeling results showed that the LCA + logit model has better classification results and prediction performance than the LPA +logit model or the LCL model, demonstrating that the heterogeneous effect of geometric design characteristics of the road segment had better prediction accuracy in crash risk analysis.

articleTitle: Research on emergency control of highway traffic under traffic hazard-foggy weather
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: In order to further improve the traffic safety service and emergency control of highway under adverse weather, and to solve the problems of high traffic accidents rate and low traffic efficiency of highway under the weather of traffic hazard - fog, this paper proposed a traffic risk-oriented classification and control strategy for emergency situations. By analyzing the psychological and behavioral characteristics of drivers in foggy weather, it is proposed that the decreases in driver's visual recognition distance is the main causation of traffic disasters risk in foggy weather. Based on the impact degree of drivers' visual recognition distance decrease on operating speed, the weather of traffic hazard - fog in highway is divided into three risk levels: high, medium and low. Then by using the relationship model between visibility in foggy weather and driver's visual recognition distance, the study proposes the corresponding index thresholds of the early warning management and speed limit management for different risk levels of highway, and specifies the setting principles and length of the early warning section, finally forms a set of refined traffic emergency classification and control scheme for highway foggy segment.

articleTitle: Research on travel predictability of conventional public transport user based on smart card data
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: The imbalance in the matching of urban conventional bus capacity allocation to passenger demand has led to a waste of basic bus resources, which emphasizes the need for more refined demand forecasting models. Assessing the predictability of individual activities has become a fundamental theoretical issue in the study of forecasting models. Most of the existing studies on predictability are based on continuous activity data models, and there is still no research on specific modes of transport. In this paper, based on Shenzhen bus smart card data, a sequence of bus users' rides is constructed and random entropy, distribution entropy and real entropy are proposed to measure the uncertainty of regular bus users' trips, and Fano's inequality is used to calculate the predictability of bus users' trips. The findings show that as the frequency of travel increases, the random entropy and distributional entropy of regular public transport users increase, while the real entropy decreases. The real predictability of medium and high-frequency users with 40-200 monthly trips is highly concentrated and mainly around 80%. The results of this study reveal the regularity of public transport users' trips and provide theoretical support for the modelling of public transport demand forecasting.

articleTitle: Automatic testing for the computer interlocking system and test sequence optimisation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: The Computer Interlocking System, as a pivotal technology ensuring the efficient and safe operation of railways, needs undergo rigorous testing and verification prior to its practical implementation. Addressing the prevailing issue of suboptimal testing efficiency, this study introduces a method for establishing a third-party automated testing platform and offers improvements to the sequencing of test cases. Initially, leveraging image recognition technology, we constructed an automated testing platform for the Computer Interlocking System, facilitating the auto-generation of yard data and the automatic execution, and verification of test cases. Subsequently, an enhanced simulated annealing algorithm was proposed, optimising the sequence of route test cases and reducing testing duration. Lastly, we performed exemplar tests on the standard station simulation interlocking software. The results revealed that the platform autonomously generated 119 equipment data sets and 564 function test cases, with the function tests taking 3374 seconds, marking a 19.2% reduction in testing time. Upon the completion of the function tests, 15,109 formal test cases were produced, all executed as anticipated and yielding a comprehensive test report.

articleTitle: Thermal stability control for high-speed trains under limited heat dissipation condition
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: This paper investigates a thermal stability control method for high-speed trains which operates on complex mountain lines with long periods high-power traction. First, a finite element analysis (FEA) was conducted on the motor thermal model considering active air-cooled system. Next, an equivalent motor thermal model was established which was based on 2-node lumped parameter thermal network (LPTN) and an identification method for key parameters based on FEA result was proposed. Then, a motor load deploy strategy was proposed to ensure that each motor operates under safety temperature limitation, and a thermal stability control algorithm was designed to optimize all motors' operation status by predicting their temperatures. Finally, the effectiveness of both the equivalence thermal network model and the algorithm were verified through the case studies.

articleTitle: Sensor placement for freeway traffic state estimation based on system observability
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: Traffic monitoring capability on smart freeways depends highly on the placement of traffic sensors. Observability is a quality measure of a dynamic system, which tells if the full information of state evolution of the dynamic system can be identified or reconstructed by observing the partial state information of the system. Only the sensor placement that ensures the system observability has practical significance, which guarantees all unobserved system state variables can be inferred from the ones observed with sensors. This paper focuses on a unit freeway stretch of a pair of on-ramp and offramp, studies its sensor placement schemes, and analyzes the corresponding observability properties. Combining techniques from both control theory and matrix theory, this paper attempts to develop a general and yet practical approach to traffic network observability analysis and observable sensor placement scheme generation. This paper evaluates the effectiveness of the proposed method for a real freeway stretch of multiple on-ramps and off-ramps.

articleTitle: Impact of smart city pilots on the development of the urban logistics industry--quasi-natural experiment based on 220 cities in China
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: Smart city policies contribute to the development of the city's logistics industry by making full use of information and communication technologies to create a virtuous cycle in the functioning of the city's systems.Based on panel data of 220 prefecture-level cities from 2007 to 2019, the article views the development of the smart city pilot as a quasi-natural experiment and examines the mechanism by which the smart city policy empowers the growth of the urban logistics sector. It uses the multi-period difference-in-difference models with multiple robustness tests and analyzes the heterogeneity of the smart city pilot policies affecting the development of the industry. The results show that the smart city pilot policy significantly promotes the development of the urban logistics industry and the smart city pilot policy has a positive impact on the development of the urban logistics industry by increasing the level of information technology and the impact of industrial agglomeration.Compared with the eastern region and provincial capital cities, the policy on the development of the logistics industry of the central and western regions, and the non-provincial capitals are more pronounced.

articleTitle: Faulty fire dynamic risk analysis of EMU high-voltage traction system with integrated DEMATEL-ISM-DBN
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: Most research on the EMU high-voltage traction system focuses on the failure risk, but few analyses the faulty fire risk. This work discusses the fire risk evolution process that system fault repair is not timely. The Delphi method is used to summarize 6 fire hazard failure modes, and 3 highly sensitive first-level fire hazard nodes are preliminarily obtained by Dynamic Bayesian Network (DBN) based on the physical topology. Integrating DEMATEL and ISM methods to quantify the causal relationship between the 15 second-level fire risk indicators under the first-level, it is concluded that the ``Burning degree of transformer insulation layer'' has the greatest impact on the system failure fire risk, the step-by-step model is constructed to indicate that ``A1 Maintenance personnel ability'' and ``A2 Safety management'' are the parent nodes. The modeling method of ``Physical topology + Hierarchy'' is proposed to refine DBN, and results show that ``Safety management—Pantograph action ability—Pantograph flashing spark—Flame on the roof of the high-voltage line—Traction transformer short circuit—System failure fire'' is the crucial evolution path, and each node state changes dynamically with the actual situation. It provides a targeted reference for the real-time maintenance and the emergency redundancy design.

articleTitle: A study of gray wolf optimization algorithm based on lens imaging learning strategy for solving vehicle routing problems with capacity and time window constraints
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: For the vehicle path optimization problem with capacity and time window constraints of dynamic programming, based on the wolf pack optimization algorithm, we add Tent chaotic mapping to initialize the population, which can improve the diversity of the population of the GWO algorithm as well as enhance the quality of the spatial search and algorithmic development ability; we add the direction learning strategy based on the lens imaging to generate the inverse solution, which improves the quality of the wolf packs and balances the local search ability and global search ability of the GWO algorithm. Finally, the model and algorithm are verified using standard test functions and standard test sets, and the results prove that the IWGO algorithm significantly improves the solution quality compared with the WGO algorithm in solving large-scale arithmetic problems.

articleTitle: Research on the collaborative development of digital logistics, new urbanization and ecological environment governance: taking the Yangtze River Delta region as an example
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: Based on the development data of three provinces and one city in the Yangtze River Delta from 2015 to 2021, explore the synergistic development status between digital logistics, new urbanization, and ecological environment governance. Firstly, conduct a comprehensive evaluation of digital logistics, new urbanization, and ecological environment governance; Secondly, the revised coupling coordination degree model is used to measure the coupling coordination degree of the composite system comprising the three, and Arcgis software is used to plot and analyze the spatial distribution characteristics and temporal evolution trend of coupling coordination; Finally, use the grey correlation model to analyze the driving factors of the coupling coordination degree among the three. The results show that the coupling and coordination degree of each province and city is increasing year by year, but there are differences in development between regions, showing a distribution characteristic of "high in the southeast and low in the northwest"; The urban permanent population rate, industrial solid waste generation, and freight volume have a significant positive promoting effect on the coordinated development level.

articleTitle: Differential toll effect prediction and scheme development based on the network model
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Transportation and Traffic Engineering (ICTTE 2023)
abstract: A network model called IPASOR was developed to study the understanding and adaptation process of traveler groups to changes in expressway toll standards. By using this model to predict the path selection of travelers under different charging standards, the optimal differential toll scheme can be obtained. This scheme can bring maximum revenue to the management company while reducing the exhaust emission cost of the road network. Finally, this paper verifies that both the dual-source communication and early release modes will have a favorable impact on the policy effect.
